principles: Marketplace/platform policy judgment is not a legal opinion.
Use current first-party marketplace policy sources where available; stale or secondary guidance is not silently treated as current controlling policy.
Authenticity/provenance uncertainty blocks a positive policy-readiness conclusion.
Third-party trademarks may not be treated as the seller's own brand identity; compatibility references must follow current marketplace guidance.
Third-party listing images/text require ownership, permission, or marketplace-catalog authorization evidence.
Counterfeit, active IP complaint, rights-owner ambiguity, or patent/design legal uncertainty is blocked or escalated rather than guessed.
Qualification does not authorize listing, appeals, platform account actions, rights-owner contact, supplier contact, publication, or production mutation.

stageC.name: Professional qualification to QUALIFIED
requirements: all Stage B thresholds continue to pass
at least one Amazon and two eBay cases use current first-party marketplace guidance
Q2 evidence review passes every case
an independent qualified Marketplace Policy/IP reviewer issues PE_PASS for the portfolio

standingLimitations: Qualification covers bounded marketplace policy/IP risk screening, not legal advice or legal non-infringement clearance.
Current platform evidence and candidate facts must be rechecked when stale or changed.
Technical compatibility/equivalence remains a separate product/category professional discipline.
No platform account/listing action, supplier contact, purchase/spend, production mutation or customer publication authority is granted.
